findings.question: q-algebra-linear-equations-inequalities-0003
findings.quote: This reverses the inequality after subtracting four. Reversal is a real rule for some operations. Check that it happens only when multiplying or dividing by a negative number.
findings.problem: The word "only" makes the sign-reversal rule too broad. Swapping the two sides also reverses the comparison sign: 2 < 5 becomes 5 > 2, without multiplying or dividing by a negative number.
findings.fix: Say: "Subtracting the same number from both sides keeps the sign. Multiplying or dividing both sides by a negative number reverses it."
